title: previous_application.decided (LOAN_HISTORY_DB)
description: One event = one row of previous_application.csv (original column names and values are kept in payload). event_time: Current submission date + DAYS_DECISION, hour = HOUR_APPR_PROCESS_START of the previous application.

event_id.description: BLAKE2b-128 of source_table + natural key. Deterministic -> use it for de-duplication.

schema_version.description: SemVer. A MAJOR change -> new topic (.v2).

event_time.description: Business time (simulated, +07:00). Current submission date + DAYS_DECISION, hour = HOUR_APPR_PROCESS_START of the previous application.

produced_at.description: Wall-clock time the producer sent the event.

customer_id.description: SK_ID_CURR of the customer; also the Kafka message key.

SK_ID_CURR.description: ID of loan in our sample

NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE.description: Contract product type (Cash loan, consumer loan [POS] ,...) of the previous application

AMT_APPLICATION.description: For how much credit did client ask on the previous application

AMT_CREDIT.description: Final credit amount on the previous application. This differs from AMT_APPLICATION in a way that the AMT_APPLICATION is the amount for which the client initially applied for, but during our approval process he could have received different amount - AMT_CREDIT

AMT_DOWN_PAYMENT.description: Down payment on the previous application

AMT_GOODS_PRICE.description: Goods price of good that client asked for (if applicable) on the previous application

WEEKDAY_APPR_PROCESS_START.description: On which day of the week did the client apply for previous application

HOUR_APPR_PROCESS_START.description: Approximately at what day hour did the client apply for the previous application

FLAG_LAST_APPL_PER_CONTRACT.description: Flag if it was last application for the previous contract. Sometimes by mistake of client or our clerk there could be more applications for one single contract

NFLAG_LAST_APPL_IN_DAY.description: Flag if the application was the last application per day of the client. Sometimes clients apply for more applications a day. Rarely it could also be error in our system that one application is in the database twice

RATE_DOWN_PAYMENT.description: Down payment rate normalized on previous credit

RATE_INTEREST_PRIMARY.description: Interest rate normalized on previous credit

RATE_INTEREST_PRIVILEGED.description: Interest rate normalized on previous credit

x-observed-values: Building a house or an annex

NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS.description: Contract status (approved, cancelled, ...) of previous application

DAYS_DECISION.description: Relative to current application when was the decision about previous application made
DAYS_DECISION.x-note: time only relative to the application

NAME_PAYMENT_TYPE.description: Payment method that client chose to pay for the previous application
x-observed-values: Cashless from the account of the employer

CODE_REJECT_REASON.description: Why was the previous application rejected

NAME_TYPE_SUITE.description: Who accompanied client when applying for the previous application

NAME_CLIENT_TYPE.description: Was the client old or new client when applying for the previous application

NAME_GOODS_CATEGORY.description: What kind of goods did the client apply for in the previous application

NAME_PORTFOLIO.description: Was the previous application for CASH, POS, CAR, …

NAME_PRODUCT_TYPE.description: Was the previous application x-sell o walk-in

CHANNEL_TYPE.description: Through which channel we acquired the client on the previous application

SELLERPLACE_AREA.description: Selling area of seller place of the previous application

CNT_PAYMENT.description: Term of previous credit at application of the previous application

NAME_YIELD_GROUP.description: Grouped interest rate into small medium and high of the previous application

PRODUCT_COMBINATION.description: Detailed product combination of the previous application

DAYS_FIRST_DRAWING.description: Relative to application date of current application when was the first disbursement of the previous application
DAYS_FIRST_DRAWING.x-note: time only relative to the application

DAYS_FIRST_DUE.description: Relative to application date of current application when was the first due supposed to be of the previous application
DAYS_FIRST_DUE.x-note: time only relative to the application

DAYS_LAST_DUE_1ST_VERSION.description: Relative to application date of current application when was the first due of the previous application
DAYS_LAST_DUE_1ST_VERSION.x-note: time only relative to the application

DAYS_LAST_DUE.description: Relative to application date of current application when was the last due date of the previous application
DAYS_LAST_DUE.x-note: time only relative to the application

DAYS_TERMINATION.description: Relative to application date of current application when was the expected termination of the previous application
DAYS_TERMINATION.x-note: time only relative to the application

NFLAG_INSURED_ON_APPROVAL.description: Did the client requested insurance during the previous application
